senses.gloss:
(ङ) प्लुङ् r. 1st cl. (प्लवते)
1 To go, to approach.
2 To go by leaps, to jump, &c.
With उत् prefixed,
To leap up.
With वि,
To plunge in, to be submerged or inundated.

m. (-क्षिः)
Fire or its deity.
E.
प्लुष to burn, Uṇādi aff. सि

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Jumped, leaped, gone by leap or jump, &c.
2 Thrown or tossed up.
m. (-तः)
1 Bounding, capering, one of a horse's paces.
3 Leaping, jumping, tumbling.
mn. (-तः-तं)
The third sound given to vowels; the protracted or continuous sound, being three times the length of the short vowel, and occupying three moments in its utterance.
E.
प्लु to go by leaps, aff. क्त.

r. 1st cl. (उ) प्लुषु (प्लोषति) r. 4th cl. (ऌ) प्लुषॢ (प्लुष्यति)
To burn.
r. 9th cl. (प्लुष्णाति)
1 To be unctuous.
2 To sprinkle.
3 To fill.
4 To set free.
5 To be fond of or kind to.

m. (-षः)
Burning, combustion.
E.
प्लुष to burn, aff. क.

(इर) प्लुसिर r. 4th cl. (प्लुस्यति)
1 To burn.
2 To share.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Burnt.
E.
प्लुष to burn, aff. क्त.
